name: Sophie
source:
[url=/c73281]Luis[/url]'s childhood friend. A cheerful and active girl who runs the famous general store "Sweet Roll Shop" together with her grandmother.

She sells potions and other adventurer-related equipment to help [url=/c73227]Lille[/url].

[Spoiler] She's had a crush on Luis for years, but he's never seen her as anything beyond a childhood friend. Depending on player agency, she might still become a couple with Luis... [/Spoiler]
